title: Thermodynamics

sections.heading: 1. First Law & Internal Energy
sections.proseLatex: $\Delta U = Q - W$. $Q$ is heat added, $W$ is work done by the system.

sections.heading: 2. Thermodynamic Processes
sections.proseLatex: Isothermal ($PV = $ const), isobaric ($P = $ const), isochoric ($V = $ const), adiabatic ($PV^\gamma = $ const).

keyFormulas.label: Adiabatic Relation
keyFormulas.aiExplainContext: No heat exchange in adiabatic processes.

workedExamples.problemLatex: System goes $a \to b$ via $acb$: $Q = 200$ J, $W = 80$ J. Via $adb$: $Q = 144$ J. Find $W$.

wbjeebTraps: Internal energy is a state function; $Q$ and $W$ are path-dependent.
